MolGPT Visual

Explore molecules invented by a GPT. The network groups similar ones, and each can be seen in 2D and in 3D.

Small model with 0.8 million parameters, trained for about 30 minutes on a CPU. Every molecule here was generated by it. Full training on a GPU should do better.
Dot size shows QED. Color shows the cluster. Gray dots have no similar molecules. Drag a dot to move the network.

Ask the GPT for a molecule

The GPT writes the molecule one piece at a time, in SMILES format. You pick the logP and QED bins and the model writes to match the request. Each piece shows a bar with the confidence the model had in that choice. Hover over a piece to see the other options it considered. The writing was recorded from the model and only the animation speed is artificial.
